subject.title: fix(sessions): prune stale entries independently of maxEntries gate

question: Should `session.maintenance.pruneAfter` remain an age-eligibility cutoff applied during pressure-batched write maintenance, or become an independent deletion trigger whenever explicit enforce maintenance loads the store?
rationale: Current code, tests, reference docs, and issue discussion support pressure batching, while the PR assumes stronger independent deletion from shorter config wording; persisted retention policy cannot be safely inferred by automation.

options.title: Preserve pressure batching
options.body: Keep the current gate and clarify config/reference wording so users understand when `pruneAfter` is applied.

options.title: Adopt independent age deletion
options.body: Approve the stronger retention policy and require clean implementation, upgrade/preservation/performance tests, and real Gateway proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve pressure batching
recommendation.body: Keep the current gate and clarify config/reference wording so users understand when `pruneAfter` is applied.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the unified pruning/capping feature and are the strongest historical owner for its intended semantics.
